findings.title: Type signature change breaks callers
findings.body: The new signature of `normalize_sku` accepts only `str`, but `receiving.py` line 12 calls it with an `int` (`barcode`). This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Restore the original signature or update the caller.

findings.title: Redundant type guard
findings.body: The guard `if not isinstance(sku, str)` is redundant because the function signature already enforces `sku: str`. Remove the guard to keep the code concise.

summary.problem: The type signature change breaks existing callers and adds an unnecessary type guard.
summary.done_well: The new docstring clearly describes the function's purpose.
